messages:
anna (Partnerships): Quick thread to line up LaunchPad onboarding to our marketplace. Main concerns: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, BYO-KMS/HSM handshake, secrets connector smoke, and an embargoed joint announcement.

ravi (PM): High-level checklist: 1) SAML metadata exchange + test 2) SCIM user/group flows + bulk import behavior 3) KMS wrap/unwrap + attestation 4) secrets end-to-end smoke 5) embargo window and co-brand text.

kai (LaunchPad): We can provide a staging SAML IdP metadata URL, SCIM staging endpoint, and a single-tenant HSM gateway for tests. Will upload artifacts shortly.

lee (Eng): Please share SAML metadata in a signed expiring link and include expected attributes (email, groups). For SCIM, we need token and callback IPs. Also want p50/p95/p99 for KMS ops.

kai (LaunchPad): Uploaded: https://staging.launchpad/files/idp-meta.xml (48h). SCIM token will be sent via secure vault. KMS staging metrics: p50=5ms, p95=20ms, p99=50ms. Attestation cert coming.

frank (Security): Requirements: IP allowlist template for SCIM, HSM attestation (cert + firmware hash), key policy for BYO-KMS, and signed SCIM webhook option. Can't enable BYO-KMS in private deployments until attestation + policy are verified.

soph (SolutionsEng): Connector smoke plan: 1) create user via SCIM 2) assign group 3) create secret via LaunchPad API 4) rotate key 5) retrieve secret from Redwood runtime. I'll draft the runbook and include retry/backoff for SCIM bulk.

lee (Eng): Example run (staging):
```
# create user
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.launchpad/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <scim>' -d '{"userName":"rbx-smoke","emails":[{"value":"eng@redwood.com"}]}'
# create secret
curl -X POST https://staging.launchpad/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api>' -d '{"name":"rbx/smoke","value":"s3cret"}'
# fetch via Redwood runtime
REDWOOD_SECRET=launchpad://rbx/smoke node scripts/get-secret.js
```
ravi (PM): Tentative schedule: internal dry-run Mon, partner validation Tue, marketplace canary Wed. Legal needs MSA redline + embargo window by Tue 11:00 PT.

legal-bot: Reminder: Upload the latest MSA redline to /collab/partners/LaunchPad before Tue 11:00 PT or the announcement will be delayed.

kai (LaunchPad): We'll push attestation, MSA redline, and SCIM telemetry by EOD tomorrow. Also can provide a VPN-backed staging HSM host if you want single-tenant testing.

frank (Security): Two open items: SCIM bulk throttling behavior (headers + Retry-After) and max concurrent KMS ops — need those to size connector queueing.

soph (SolutionsEng): We'll implement jittered exponential backoff and a small in-memory queue for bursts. I'll attach the test scripts to the calendar invite.

anna (Partnerships): Action items: Kai upload attestation, metadata, MSA redline, and telemetry (by EOD tomorrow). Lee/Soph finalize runbook + backoff (by Mon AM). Frank provide IP allowlist template (today). Ravi draft embargo + announcement copy (by Mon).

anna (Partnerships): Scheduling a 30-min smoke-run call Tue 09:00 PT 10. Invite with runbook & checklist coming. Reminder: Marketing copy stays internal until Legal signs off.

kai (LaunchPad): Acknowledged. We'll join with infra lead.

lee (Eng): I'll be on the call with the staging harness ready.

frank (Security): I'll sign off on the checklist during the call.

anna (Partnerships): Thanks everyone.
